title: Lucinda Patterson:
format: 16:9 only · 1920×1080 (Atdhe, Frame.io 26 Oct: “This video should be horizontal”)
headline: CASS's Chief Financial Officer answers the interviewer's questions one by one and tells donors the one thing she wants them to know: clients come first, and their gifts are not used frivolously.
story: This is the long, horizontal version of Lucinda's interview. Each answer starts with the interviewer's question, so a viewer never has to catch up to her story (Zsirai's ask on the 31 Aug call).

She came from 20 years in construction into mission work. She explains why she is careful with every gift, why clients come first, and why a donor can trust where it goes. She ends warm: the job is fulfilling and makes her a better person.
The fix list is short: B-roll only from CASS BROLL 3.mov and spread through the whole video, music back in, horizontal, and the caption fixes below.
